passage: The school library has a new scanner. It works correctly every time, so it is a (1) ___ piece of equipment. We can (2) ___ on it even on busy days. Our student volunteers (3) ___ readers in locating books. One student, Mina, kept putting off her decision to join because she was unsure. This showed her (4) ___. She finally signed up after talking to a friend. The daily (5) ___ of the library includes opening the doors, lending books, and recording returns. Each volunteer helps with one of these tasks.
